summary.intent: Commit a spike PreToolUse hook that validates gate handbacks against their verdict schemas, and log the Wave 0 findings in the evaluations docs.
summary.outcome: Two commits were made: one adding tools/validate-handback.py with tests/test_handback_validator.py, and one updating docs/evaluations with the Wave 0 log and findings. The hook is not yet registered by any plugin.

repo: Gate agents' output schemas are not reliably enforced by prompts alone, which motivated a validator hook.
In auto mode a SubagentStop hook only sees the closing text, because the delivered report goes through SubagentHandback. Validation therefore has to be a PreToolUse hook reading tool_input.message.
The validator checks exit-gate handbacks against verdict@1 or verdict@3, including conditional rules. It denies with the errors, caps denials at three per agent, and fails open on internal errors.
Run over 45 recorded gate verdicts, the only violation class found was verdict_summary over 300 characters (12 of 45).
Muse gates mostly emit verdict@3 even though muse documents verdict@1, so the docs and behavior disagree.
The cross-harness authoring guide requires a change record for this kind of work, and the evaluations log now includes one.
No version, changelog or tag changed for the Wave 0 work.

code.finding: The validator had a bug with list-typed schema properties. It was fixed and covered by a regression test in tests/test_handback_validator.py.

workflow: Commit the tooling spike and the docs/evaluations log as separate commits, with the second recording what the first found.
Include a script that reproduces a finding in the docs so the result can be verified.
Fail-open hooks with a denial cap keep an experimental validator from blocking agents.

friction: A SubagentStop hook cannot validate delivered reports in auto mode, which forced a different hook placement.
Prompt-only instructions did not keep gates to their output schema.
The 300-character limit on verdict_summary was violated in 12 of 45 recorded verdicts.
open_items: Register the validator hook in a plugin. It is not registered anywhere yet.
Resolve the mismatch between muse's documented verdict@1 and the verdict@3 that muse gates actually emit.
Investigate how the community Antigravity CLI discovers plugins.
Address the verdict_summary length violations, either through prompts or through enforcement by the hook.
Continue the remaining Wave 0 work packages.
